subject: Request: One-time credit + SLA overlay to retain Northbridge
messages:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-30T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion — pricing and SLA requirements

Mateo,

Thanks for the renewal reminder. We ran the numbers this morning and, with our fiscal constraints for FY29, the current renewal pricing and standard SLA don't fit within our procurement guardrails. Two items to highlight: 1) we need guaranteed 99.95% availability SLA for our production inference endpoint (medical triage), and 2) our internal budget only allows for ~60% of the quoted ARR unless we get a one-time offset in year 1.

We value Redwood's runtime — it's been reliable — but we are actively reviewing alternatives because of the cost. I attached our renewal intent and procurement timeline. Can your team propose a one-time credit or term adjustment that lands the effective first-year cost within our budget? Procurement needs an answer by Wednesday EOD to stay on their cadence.

Best,
Sarah Lee
VP Product, Northbridge Systems
procurement-nb@northbridge.com
Attachment: Northbridge_Renewal_Intent.pdf
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com>
Cc: procurement-nb@northbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-30T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — pricing and SLA requirements

Hi Sarah — thank you for the candid note and the timeline.

Quick summary: we want to keep Northbridge on Redwood. I reviewed options with the pricing toolkit and attached a proposed save package (NB_Save_Package_v1.xlsx) that includes a one-time year-1 credit, a 12-month term reset to align your procurement, and an SLA overlay to 99.95% for the first 6 months. The package is intentionally conservative on credits but preserves gross ARR for Redwood.

If that package doesn't meet procurement's target I can escalate for an exec-level exception. If you agree, I'll move to a short mutual-action plan and loop legal for a one-off amendment.

Next steps I propose: 1) you confirm the acceptance of the package by Wed EOD, or 2) I escalate internally with a recommended ask (details below).

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: NB_Save_Package_v1.xlsx
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Northbridge renewal — exec authorization requested

Team — forwarding the thread with Northbridge. Short ask and rationale below. Please see attached Save_Rationale_Deck.pdf.

Customer: Northbridge Systems (strategic healthcare vertical).
Renewal at risk: ~$1.2M ARR (annualized) — FY29 start.
Customer asks: 1) 99.95% SLA overlay for production for 6+ months, 2) one-time offset to bring first-year effective cost down to ~60% of quoted renewal, 3) term reset to 12 months to align procurement.

Proposed save package (what I recommend we push as a formal offer):
- One-time credit = 20% of renewal invoice year 1 (applied as invoice credit)
- SLA overlay to 99.95% for first 6 months (operationally feasible with dedicated infra pin)
- Term reset to 12 months with standard T&Cs (legal amendment required)

Why approve: Northbridge is in regulated healthcare, high churn risk if they switch vendors due to data integrations, and they are an active prospect for our Dedicated offering next year. The revenue risk of churn is material; the requested credit is one-off and preserves future expansion.

Decision requested: Exec approval to offer the proposed package or counter (I need a final decision by EOD Tuesday so I can respond to procurement). If approved, legal will need to prepare an amendment and finance should confirm the credit mechanics.

Attachments: Save_Rationale_Deck.pdf (cost/impact and churn analysis), NB_Save_Package_v1.xlsx (customer-facing offer).

Quoted below: 

On 2028-06-30 08:12, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@northbridge.com> wrote:
> Mateo,
> 
> Thanks for the renewal reminder....
> 
> Attachment: Northbridge_Renewal_Intent.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-02T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Northbridge renewal — exec authorization requested

Thanks for the clear summary, Mateo. Reviewed the deck and the ARR risk. I approve a one-time credit and SLA overlay with the following guardrails: 

1) Credit: approve 20% one-time credit for year 1 (applied as invoice credit). Finance (Evelyn) to confirm implementation and P&L impact; do not commit higher without CFO approval.
2) SLA overlay: approve 99.95% SLA overlay for 6 months, provided Infra/Oncall confirm capacity pin and runbook. Ops must sign off before we send to customer.
3) Term reset: Legal must review amendment language; we will not extend commercial discounts beyond the first 12 months.

Mateo — you have approval to offer the package above. Please coordinate with Evelyn for the credit mechanics and copy Legal on the amendment. Capture acceptance in HubSpot (deal NB-2028-0042).

Marissa Cole
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference

--
